futures.funding_sign_convention: ACCOUNT CASHFLOW, not the market funding rate. Negative = funding PAID out of the account, positive = funding RECEIVED, whichever side the position is on. This is NOT the direction-agnostic rate a short-side framework means by 'positive funding is income to a short' — a LONG paying a positive-rate funding books NEGATIVE here. Use this figure ONLY for a realized 'cumulative funding paid' column; an annualized carry rate at entry must come from a live rate quote.
futures.funding_window: Grouped per base asset from crypto_futures_income where income_type = FUNDING_FEE, over the full synced history. GRAIN GAP: the ledger knows funding per SYMBOL and never per tranche (futures never enters the cost-basis engine), so a per-tranche carry ledger must allocate this manually. It is 1:1 only while a single tranche is live.
futures.fills_coverage_note: Raw futures fills are exported from crypto_futures_trade without truncation. The order-level trades list may be bounded separately; see trades_truncated.

carry.window: Cross margin only, over the synced backfill window. Isolated margin is not synced, so an isolated borrow's carry is MISSING, not zero.
carry.scope_note: SPOT/MARGIN FINANCING ONLY — interest charged in the borrowed asset, which is a different mechanism from futures funding under `futures`. Do not sum the two without saying which is which. An empty open_borrows list means nothing was borrowed at the last POST /link (see borrows_as_of), NOT that nothing was ever borrowed — the history of that is interest_by_asset, since interest cannot accrue on a borrow that never existed.
